title: GUM-SAGE: A Novel Dataset and Approach for Graded Entity Salience Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing false positive and false negative rates of salient entity predictions across the first and second halves of documents to measure the models' tendency to favor entities mentioned early in the text.

Evaluating model performance metrics (precision, recall, and F1 scores) across different semantic entity categories (e.g., PERSON, ORGANIZATION vs. ABSTRACT, TIME) to identify overpredictions for common, concrete entities compared to conceptual ones.
Examining confusion matrices to identify model tendencies to systematically overpredict moderate or high salience scores due to skewed training data distributions.
